frequency_question: What proportion of calendar years containing scheduled FOMC meeting cycles successfully execute at least one interest rate reduction action?
membership_rule: Includes any calendar year with 8 regularly scheduled FOMC meetings where rate actions are structurally permitted; excludes years with no scheduled meetings or structural dissolution of the committee.
provenance_note: 7 cases named, 11 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.6x)
coverage_note: 11 annual cycles evaluated; fully covers the relevant structural periodicity of FOMC rate-setting intervals.
known_gaps: None; regular meeting schedules are fixed well in advance by statute and calendar rules.
skeleton: Total annual FOMC meeting cycles since 2015 evaluated for rate cuts within the calendar year
multiplier: 5 hits out of 11 observed historical cycles (2015-2025 inclusive)
validity_reason: The institutional framework and meeting frequency of the FOMC are governed by long-standing statutory rules that remain stable across multiple years.
